svg.text: The timeless calligraphic Urtext rest: a double hook for a
16th, a single hook for an 8th, the serpentine lightning
glyph for a quarter and a solid 6 × 2.5pt block for a half
— instantly recognizable to any reader. The system opens on
the delicate 0.50pt bracket with 2.5pt spurs, and the grid
is strict: barlines and beat pulses alike are painted
through dedicated white air channels above the rhythm
layer, so no stem or beam may ever overwrite a grid line.
